items.headline: K-Jungman Cup winner Bakhaak leaves K University for The K
items.summary: K University's tier-5 zerg Bakhaak said goodbye to the team on October 9 and introduced themselves as a new member of The K. They wrote that they won the K-Jungman Cup with a 6-1 record. Bakhaak came back to StarCraft last February and thanked their teachers Seokhyeon, ggaemo and Soyun.
items.card: K University zerg Bakhaak says goodbye and moves to The K
items.id: 2026-10-09:K-Jungman Cup winner Bakhaak leaves K University for The K
items.teaser: K University's tier-5 zerg Bakhaak says goodbye to the team and joins The K. They look back on returning to StarCraft last February and thank their teachers Seokhyeon, ggaemo and Soyun.

items.headline: New World signs youth players Ppokkaengi and a player
items.summary: New World officially welcomed two new youth players, Ppokkaengi and a player. Ppokkaengi had been doing music streams for six months and decided after a few days of thought to try the youth program. On the same day, EloBoard's player records also moved Motokei to New World, though no announcement was posted.
